owner_decisions: Success contains only requested explicit affixes; empty affix slots and implicits remain outside the exactness restriction.
Intermediate junk and temporary crafts remain legal and are removed only when useful or required for terminal success.
Carrier planning may jump between any feasible goal subsets and does not impose a fixed goal order.
The first diagnostic requests ordinary bounded finalization after sixty seconds; it does not claim exact closure.
